subject.title: transcripts: show prints stored terminal escapes from imported text

question: Should transcript summary sanitization happen when generating persisted summary artifacts, only when `openclaw transcripts show` writes to a terminal, or both?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but the repair changes a security boundary and artifact-fidelity contract for imported transcript text, stored markdown, JSON summary content, and terminal output.

options.title: Sanitize generated summaries before persistence
options.body: Remove terminal control sequences from summary fields before writing generated summary artifacts, while leaving raw `transcript.jsonl` as the source artifact.

options.title: Sanitize only terminal output
options.body: Keep stored summary artifacts byte-preserving and sanitize the plain `transcripts show` stdout path only.

options.title: Sanitize both artifact and display paths
options.body: Use persistence sanitization plus a defensive display sanitizer, accepting duplicate protection for this security-sensitive boundary.

recommendation.title: Sanitize generated summaries before persistence
recommendation.body: Remove terminal control sequences from summary fields before writing generated summary artifacts, while leaving raw `transcript.jsonl` as the source artifact.

likelyOwner.reason: The core transcripts feature and adjacent terminal sanitizer hardening both trace to this owner in recent history.
